_notice: SYNTHETIC thresholds for an independent prototype. Not calibrated against real network data.

sufficiency_rules.strong: At least two independent fresh measured signals support the hypothesis and no fresh measurement opposes it.
sufficiency_rules.moderate: One fresh measured signal supports it, corroborated by a statement or note; or two signals with one measured opposition.
sufficiency_rules.weak: Only customer statements, analyst notes or stale measurements support it.
sufficiency_rules.insufficient: No fresh measured signal is available for the relevant period.
